note: Writes and reads a byte on the console's own serial manager, which needs no wiring. -S is exercised only on cdc1, a USB CDC port with no console behind it where a baud rate means nothing: -S on the console's manager reconfigures it 8N1 at another rate and would cut the session.

tests.note: argv[1] used to be read before argc was checked: it held whatever an earlier command left there - a garbage manager name on Discovery_N657, a NULL and a HardFault on Nucleo_H743 right after restart (fixed, ../DEFECTS.md)

the byte 0x41 goes out on the console itself, so 'A' lands just before the report. -W used to try once and report 'general problem' when the UART was still sending wkserial's own banner - an intermittent failure, 7 in 20 on Discovery_N657 after a reset (fixed, ../DEFECTS.md)
